<function name="GetEnableShadows" parent="ProjectedTexture" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether shadows are enabled for this ProjectedTexture, which was previously set by <page>ProjectedTexture:SetEnableShadows</page></description>

	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether shadows are enabled.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
